scripts.lint: turbo run lint lint:root check:config check:format
scripts.ci:root: turbo run lint:root check:config check:format test:harness test:checks --continue
scripts.ci:affected: turbo run lint typecheck test build --affected --continue
scripts.stack:up: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --eval "for (const name of ['API_HOST', 'API_PORT', 'WEB_HOST', 'WEB_PORT']) if (!process.env[name]) { console.error('stack:up: set ' + name + ' (documented in .env.example)'); process.exitCode = 1; }" && docker compose --profile api --profile web up --build --detach --wait
scripts.stack:seed: docker compose --profile api run --rm api node dist/cli/seed.js
scripts.stack:api-keys: docker compose --profile api run --rm api node dist/cli/api-keys.js
scripts.stack:down: docker compose --profile api --profile web rm --stop --force web api migrate
